_comment: Two groups that import each other: `ga` holds `a.js`, which imports `b.cjs` from `gb`, and `gb` holds `d.js`, which imports `e.cjs` from `ga`. `includeDependenciesRecursively: false` keeps each group to the modules its `test` matches, which is what forms the chunk cycle. ESM evaluates `gb` first, so `d.js` calls `require_e()` before `ga` has run; the wrapper must already be callable then.
